newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Bond market takes Tunis bourse trade up.
newsitem.headline: Bond market takes Tunis bourse trade up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed up by 0.06 percent in higher trade boosted by the bond market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 472.74 from 472.47 on Monday.
Volume was 5.39 million dinars against 1.08 million dinars. Most of the trade was on the bond's market with a turnover of 4.50 million dinars, brokers said.
Chemical firm ICF reversed its downward trend and was up 1.06 dinars to 36.64 dinars after it fell by 29.34 percent last week.
STB bank was down 0.6 dinar to 19.4 dinars. Tunisie Leasing declined 0.88 dinar to 28.32 dinars. Detergents firm SPCD eased 0.78 dinar to 25.58 dinars. ($= 1.04 dinars)
